scope: Two-to-three-month preparation for approximately 24 months of owner absence during Vietnam military service

verified.claim: Vietnam military service law Article 21 sets peacetime active service at 24 months, with statutory extension conditions.
FINRA algorithmic-trading guidance covers risk assessment, code development, testing/system validation, trading systems and compliance, including system-problem tracking and risk-control review.
NIST AI RMF provides an official AI-risk governance framework.
17 CFR 240.15c3-5 is a primary market-access risk-control reference; direct applicability depends on venue and jurisdiction.

inferences: Owner absence makes continuity, recovery, reconciliation and capital preservation higher priority than adding models.
Institutional automated trading is normally supported by monitoring, controls and people; it is not evidence that a solo bot can run unattended for 24 months with stable profit.
AI should remain typed advisory/ranking/anomaly/research output; deterministic risk and execution layers own authority.
unknowns: Vietnam-specific tax, digital-asset/venue status and broker terms for the chosen instrument.
MFA, KYC, account-recovery and lawful-delegation options for the chosen venue.
Actual strategy edge after fees, slippage, latency, market impact and regime changes.
Whether the owner can access communications or approve actions during service.
must_have: Deterministic baseline and causal data contract
30-60 day paper/forward soak with zero unexplained reconciliation drift
Least-privilege API, withdrawal disabled, IP allowlist, separate small account
24/7 host observability, backup/restore and outage drills
24-month capital reserve and explicit stop policy
AI cannot self-promote, self-edit risk limits or open execution authority
defer: PPO/SAC/MuZero and other RL execution policies
HFT tick engine, QPU, SNN/neuromorphic, self-evolving live agents
Prompt-to-order, wallet/custody/DEX execution and high leverage
Multi-venue complexity before one venue has passed gates

critical_path_days.1-14: Contracts, risk budget, venue/legal/account continuity and absence runbook
critical_path_days.15-35: Canonical data, deterministic baseline, costs, OOS/WFO and locked holdout
critical_path_days.36-60: Paper/forward plus fault injection and restore/reconciliation drills
critical_path_days.76-90: Capped live only if all gates pass; otherwise paper/research only

go_no_go: No unreconciled fills or position drift
Fault injection, restart, restore and outage drills pass
API/account security and recovery path verified
Drawdown/ruin fits predefined VND risk budget and reserve
No unbounded AI execution or self-modification
limitations: Web tool returned errors for some current regulatory pages; non-verified pages were not used as evidence.
This artifact is not legal, tax or investment advice.
No broker, exchange, OAuth, account or live-trading access was opened.
